ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 85% high-intensity (white/light-grey) surface area vs 15% low-intensity (black) markings and borders.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region consists of a high-intensity contiguous field. A thick, irregular low-intensity (black) band follows the entire trailing edge perimeter. Distinct low-intensity pixel clusters are concentrated at the median notch vertex and as scattered striations and spots across the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with a calculated internal angle of approximately 45 degrees relative to the lobe baselines.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing edge; irregular peaks and valleys with pixel amplitudes ranging from 2 to 8 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primary convex sweep from notch to tip, transitioning to a slight concavity near the terminal distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, discrete circular low-intensity clusters visible on the lower-left quadrant and distal right lobe margin.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A set of four distinct, roughly parallel dark linear streaks (rake marks) identified on the left lobe extending from mid-fluke toward the trailing edge; isolated diagonal scratches on the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Likely rake marks on the left lobe; irregular pigmentation massing at the central notch apex.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetrical pigmentation distribution, with the left lobe exhibiting significantly more linear scarring and larger discrete low-intensity splotches compared to the relatively cleaner right lobe surface.
